Name: (CP Livestock) Everia's Dragons for 1.6
Author: Drag00nSpirit
Description:
My very first published mod! This mod brings [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4467]Everia's Dragons[/url] to Content Patcher for Stardew v1.6, adding 12 colors of dragons as new barn livestock. Now that CP can add new livestock, BFAV is no longer needed! I've also taken the liberty of adjusting the dragon's produce to be a bit more flavorful, and tweaked their prices. Let me know if you feel anything is unbalanced! This has been tested and everything should be working properly, but please let me know if I missed anything!

The dragons bring you a bit of gold ore, and once you're good friends they'll bring you their favorite gemstones.


INSTALLATION INSTRUCTIONS
Download the mod and extract the .zip into your Mods folder. You do not need to use the original BFAV mod alongside this, they are separate mods which accomplish the same thing.


IF INSTALLING ON AN EXISTING SAVE
You'll need to sell any dragons you currently own, save and exit the game, then remove the BFAV version and install this one. Unfortunately I can't make this seamlessly replace your dragons, you'll need to buy them again.


FUTURE PLANS
[s]Make the dragons into variants of a single creature, the way chickens are[/s] DONE!
